tools.name: slow_queries
tools.description: List the statements that took the most execution time in a Postgres database, from pg_stat_statements: calls, mean, max and total time in milliseconds, rows, cache hits and reads, and the statement's text. Counts are totals since the statistics were last reset. Needs the pg_stat_statements extension; when it is missing, use running_queries for what runs now.

database.description: The database to read, by the name Sidekick's settings give it.

limit.description: The most rows to return, 1 to 100. Default 20.

minMeanMs.description: Only statements whose mean execution time is at least this many milliseconds. Default 0.

orderBy.description: Order by the mean time of one call (mean) or the total time of all calls (total). Default mean.

tools.name: running_queries
tools.description: List the sessions of a Postgres database that are running a query or holding a transaction open, longest running first, from pg_stat_activity: user, application, client address, state, wait event, how long the query and the transaction have run, the sessions blocking it, and the query's text.

database.description: The database to read, by the name Sidekick's settings give it.

limit.description: The most rows to return, 1 to 100. Default 20.

minDurationMs.description: Only sessions whose query or open transaction has run at least this many milliseconds. Default 0.

tools.name: lock_waits
tools.description: List the sessions of a Postgres database that are waiting for a lock, longest waiting first, from pg_locks and pg_stat_activity: the lock, how long each has waited, and the sessions blocking it. Also lists every blocking session, and the ones at the head of each blocking chain, which block others without waiting themselves.

database.description: The database to read, by the name Sidekick's settings give it.

limit.description: The most rows to return, 1 to 100. Default 20.

minWaitMs.description: Only sessions that have waited at least this many milliseconds. Default 0.
